title: Liveness check

camera.permissionBody: Allow camera access to verify a live person is holding this device. Frames are processed on-device and never stored or uploaded.
camera.deniedBody: Camera access for Nadir Wallet is turned off, so the liveness check can't run. Turn it on in Settings to continue. Nothing was approved.
camera.noDeviceBody: This device has no front camera, so the liveness check can't run here. Nothing was approved.
camera.unavailableBody: The liveness check couldn't start or stopped unexpectedly. Nothing was approved. Close this and try again.

align: Fit your whole face inside the oval

challenge.turnLeft: Turn your head to the left
challenge.turnRight: Turn your head to the right

failedTimeout: That took too long — try again in good lighting.
scopeNote: Active liveness demo — on-device, nothing leaves your phone.
